subject: mathematics
title: Multiplying 9 by 3
objective: Multiply 9 by 3 using equal groups and place value.
introduction: Milo fills 9 jars with 3 fireflies in each jar. How many fireflies are there altogether?

items.prompt: Milo puts 3 fireflies in each of 9 jars. How many fireflies are there altogether?
items.explanation: 9 × 3 means 9 groups of 3, and 9 × 3 = 27. Count by threes: 3, 6, 9, 12, 15, 18, 21, 24, 27.

items.prompt: Two jars hold 7 fireflies each. How many fireflies are in the jars?
items.explanation: Three groups of seven is 7 + 7 + 7 = 21, so the product is 21.

items.prompt: Milo sees 3 groups of 7 fireflies. Which multiplication sentence matches?
items.explanation: Three groups of seven is written 3 × 7, and 3 × 7 = 21 because 7 + 7 + 7 = 21.

items.prompt: Three groups of seven shows what?
items.explanation: Three groups of seven means 7 objects in each of 3 groups, like 3 boxes with 7 marbles each.
3 groups of 7 has the same number of items in every group, so it uses equal groups. Adding and subtracting do not make equal groups.
